# Provenance — from a session back to the code that ran

*Generated by Claude Fable 5 (Anthropic), 2026-08-24.*

A FISH session tells you which callbacks executed. The provenance layer
answers the next questions — **which binaries, which packages, which source
files and which include chains** were actually used — with four layers, each
narrowing the previous one. It exists so that expected-vs-counted
verification (the A2 method used on Isaac ROS) becomes tractable on a stack
the size of Autoware: instead of reviewing 465 packages, review the ~100
translation units behind the callbacks that fired.

| layer | from → to | source of truth | produced by |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | runtime → binaries | `/proc/<pid>/maps` of every ROS process (exe + all mapped `.so`) | `snapshot/maps_libs_stable.json` (daemon, at `system_stable`) and `maps_libs_shutdown.json` (`shutdown_snapshot`) |
| 2 | binaries → packages | install layout (`lib/<pkg>/<exe>`), ament resource index (`rclcpp_components` `class;lib`), pluginlib XML, `ament_cmake_export_libraries`, `lib<pkg>*` heuristics | `fish.provenance` → `provenance/packages.json` |
| 3 | symbols → sources | `ros2:rclcpp_callback_register` symbols (fired = `callback_start` seen) resolved against a universal-ctags index of **the sources the image was built from** | `provenance/symbols.json` |
| 4 | sources → includes | `<cc> -E -H` per translation unit with the flags from a configure-only `compile_commands.json` | `provenance/includes.json` |

## Image side (`scripts/install_provenance.sh`, baked into `-fishwait6`)

The Autoware images ship no sources, no `compile_commands.json` and no
DWARF; only the install space (465 packages) with exported symbols. The
installer therefore reconstructs the build inputs:

1. `git clone autowarefoundation/autoware` at the **OCI revision of the base
   image** (`org.opencontainers.image.revision`, e.g. `5dfb0900…` for
   `universe-devel-cuda-20260401`) and `vcs import --shallow` of
   `repositories/autoware.repos` (+ `extra-packages.repos`) into
   `/opt/fish_provenance/src`.
2. `versions.json` — installed `package.xml` version vs source version, per
   package (the honesty check that the sources are the ones compiled).
3. `tags` — `universal-ctags -R --extras=+q` (qualified C++ names → file:line).
4. `build/<pkg>/compile_commands.json` — **CMake configure only** (no
   compilation) for every package present in both install and source, with
   the installed workspace sourced so `find_package` resolves. Failures are
   logged per package (`configure.log`), never fatal.
5. `manifest.json` — revision, counts.

Build: `scripts/build_fishwait6.sh` (fresh container from the unchanged
`-fishwait5`, repo copied in, `install_fish.sh` refreshed, installer run,
`docker commit` as a new tag; refuses to overwrite an existing tag).

## Session side (`ros2 run fish provenance <session_dir>` / `python3 -m fish.provenance`)

Runs inside a fishwait6-class container (or anywhere `/opt/fish_provenance`
is mounted) and writes `<session>/provenance/`:

* `packages.json` — per process: exe, mapped libs, package per lib; per
  package: pids/libs/exes; the list of installed-but-never-mapped packages.
* `symbols.json` — every registered callback: symbol, parsed kind, fired?,
  owning package, ctags hits (file:line). Symbol kinds:
  `function` (`ns::Class::method(...)`), `class` (`std::_Bind<void (ns::Class::*…` —
  the member-function pointer type carries the class, not the method: resolved
  to class level), `lambda_in` (`…::method(...)::{lambda…}` → the enclosing
  method), `python` (`module.qualname`), `opaque` (`std::function<…>`: the
  callback type only — not resolvable at the ROS layer), `unknown`.
* `includes.json` — for the source files behind the FIRED callbacks: the TU,
  its package, direct includes, total includes, max depth.
* `report.md` — the numbers above as a readable summary.

Options: `--no-includes`, `--max-tus N`, `--prov/--install/--ros` roots.

## Limits (state them when you use the numbers)

* Layer 1 is a snapshot in time: processes that exited before `system_stable`
  or `stop` (transient `ros2` CLI calls, the bag player, nsys-wrapped
  containers stopped by the graceful nsys shutdown) appear only in the trace,
  not in `maps_libs_*`. The trace-derived EX list is the timeline truth.
* Layer 3 resolves what `get_symbol()` gives: `std::function` targets and
  `std::bind` method names are not recoverable without DWARF/uprobes
  (`notes/plan_uprobe_join_verification.txt` is the instrument for that).
* Layer 4 reflects the configure-time flags of a clean checkout; packages
  whose configure failed (logged) have no include graph.
